note: Recorded requirements for module RPT (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: District dashboard of pending applications
requirements.description: The system shall show the District Social Welfare Officer a dashboard of applications by status for the district, with pending applications of each institution and the working days each has been pending, refreshed every 15 minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: Given 12 applications pending with an institution, when the DSWO opens the dashboard, then the institution row shows 12 with the oldest pending days.

requirements.title: Monthly report to the Principal Secretary
requirements.description: The system shall generate on the 1st of every month a report for the Principal Secretary, Social Welfare, with district-wise applications received, sanctioned, rejected, paid and pending, as PDF and Excel.
acceptanceCriteria: Given month end, when the report is generated, then district totals match the application data as of the last day of the month.

requirements.title: Right to Service compliance report
requirements.description: The system shall report, for each district, applications that exceeded the 30 working day service timeline, with the stage at which the delay occurred.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an application sanctioned on working day 34, when the report runs, then it is listed with the stage that exceeded its SLA.

requirements.title: Payment reconciliation report
requirements.description: The system shall report sanctioned, paid, failed and pending payments by district and PFMS batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a PFMS batch, when the report is opened, then paid, failed and pending counts add up to the batch size.
